user.title: Fuel prices in Lithuania
user.description: This integration uses the same data source as the official fuel price map of the Lithuanian Energy Agency (LEA). The access token can be discovered automatically from the LEA website. Data source – the Lithuanian Energy Agency (LEA), {source_url}. Primary fuel price data providers – the companies operating the stations. This is an independent third-party integration. Its author is responsible for its operation, data retrieval, updating and display. LEA does not create or administer this integration.

token.title: Access token
token.description: Paste the access token. It can be found on the LEA website, but usually you do not need to look for it – the integration discovers it automatically.

city.title: City filter
city.description: The municipality has {stations} stations. The filter "{prefix}" keeps {matching}. Leave the field empty to use the whole municipality.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the access token
reauth_confirm.description: LEA rejected the stored access token. Paste a new one.

reconfigure.title: Change the municipality
reconfigure.description: Current municipality: {current}. Changing it clears the city filter and the station sensors, because they belong to the previous municipality.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the LEA data source.
error.invalid_auth: The access token is invalid or has expired.
error.token_not_found: The access token could not be discovered automatically. Enter it manually.

abort.already_configured: This municipality has already been added.
abort.reauth_failed: Could not update the access token.
abort.no_data: LEA currently publishes no fuel prices for the selected municipality.

init.title: Fuel prices in Lithuania
init.description: Stations matching the city filter: {stations}. With dedicated sensors: {selected}.

stations.title: Monitored stations
stations.description: Select the stations that should get a dedicated sensor. Stations in the list: {count}. Each selected station creates one sensor.

confirm_all.title: Confirm monitoring every station
confirm_all.description: Warning: {count} sensors will be created, one per station. This increases the entity registry size and recorder load.

data.confirm: Yes, I understand how many sensors this creates
